description: The image depicts a small bathroom with a toilet, featuring four rolls of toilet paper attached to the wall above it. The wall is painted gray, complemented by white trim and a white ceiling. The toilet, situated in the bottom right corner of the image, is topped with a decorative owl-shaped toilet paper holder. The toilet itself is white, with a closed lid, and is positioned against the back wall of the room. The overall atmosphere suggests a clean and well-maintained bathroom.
